messages:
lisa: Hi team — auditor just asked for proof that the RBAC change from last week followed our approval workflow and that KMS key usage around the change is traceable. Need a concise artifact they can ingest.
security_ops: Got it. Which change specifically? The one where svc-account `inference-deployer` got cluster-admin?
lisa: yes — PR #3421 merged 2026-01-12 03:20 UTC. Auditor wants: (1) change approval chain (who approved + timestamps), (2) audit logs showing the role bind applied, (3) KMS access events for the service-account's key usage during the change window, and (4) incident/triage notes if any anomalous activity occurred.
kevin: I can export the RBAC approval thread (GitHub) and the PR review timeline. For k8s RBAC binding we can pull `kubectl get rbacrolebinding` history from audit logs. Quick query I run in Splunk:
```
index=infra_k8s source=kube_audit verb=update object_ref.kind=RoleBinding OR object_ref.kind=ClusterRoleBinding user.name="gitops-bot" earliest="2026-01-12:00:00" latest="2026-01-13:00:00"
```
That returns the patch payload and who executed it.
maria: For KMS, our Cloud KMS logs are in LogSink -> splunk_kms. Example query (Stackdriver style) we used previously:
```
resource.type="kms_key" protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricSign"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail: "inference-deployer@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
timestamp>="2026-01-12T00:00:00Z" AND timestamp<="2026-01-13T00:00:00Z"
```
This returns key id and operation details.
auditor_james: Thanks. For evidence package we prefer CSV or JSONL exports with these fields: event_time, actor, action, resource, request_id, raw_event_link. Also we need a short narrative tying the items together (1 paragraph). Can you include a runbook reference for how changes are approved?
security_ops: We have the approval runbook at https://internal.redwood/runbooks/rbac-change-approval. I can attach a screenshot and the approver audit trail export. Also note: there was an ATO exception ticket (TICKET-889) open for temporary elevated access — I'll include that with timestamps.
lisa: Good — also auditor asked if any vuln scans or incidents coincided with that timespan. Kevin, can you confirm if there were any security alerts for the deployer SA that day?
kevin: Running a quick query against our vuln/alert index: `index=sec_alerts subject="inference-deployer" earliest=2026-01-11:00:00 latest=2026-01-14:00:00` — result: one medium alert (scanner: static-analysis) flagged a deprecated dependency in the deployer image, not an auth/priv escalation. I'll include the alert ID (SA-4521) and triage notes: marked low risk, no lateral movement indicators.
maria: KMS logs show two AsymmetricSign operations by the service account at 03:18 and 03:22 UTC — both correlate to a signed artifact upload by CI. I'll export the raw events and redact any sensitive payload fields.
security_ops: I'll assemble a package:
- approvals.csv (GitHub PR reviewers + timestamps)
- kube_rbac_events.jsonl (audit events showing the RoleBinding change)
- kms_key_usage.csv (exported KMS events for the SA)
- ticket_TICKET-889.pdf (ATO exception)
- alert_triage.md (SA-4521 notes)
- runbook_link.txt (link + one-paragraph narrative)
I can push to the auditor S3 bucket with a presigned URL.
auditor_james: Presigned link is fine. Please include checksums for each file. Also attach the exact Splunk/Logsight queries you ran so the auditor can reproduce.
lisa: If possible include a short timeline in the narrative that ties PR merge -> rolebind apply -> KMS operations -> CI artifact upload -> ticket close. Auditor wants to see causality.
security_ops: Will do. One more ask from me: should we sanitize principal emails for the package? Auditor needs the full principal identity for attestation. We should keep original but mark PII handling in the manifest.
maria: Agree keep originals but document redaction policy. I'll include a manifest.json (metadata-only) describing fields and redaction notes.
deploy-bot: Automated export complete: uploads/3509991234/rbac_kms_package_v1.tar.gz (presigned expires in 7 days) :white_check_mark:
kevin: Uploaded checksums: md5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e, sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924... (truncated)
lisa: Great work — I'll reply to auditor with the presigned link + one-paragraph narrative and attach the runbook. Closing loop in this thread once they've acknowledged. :thumbsup:
